l-e-e3-b04-06.title: Rarraba manyan haruffan da aka rubuta da madaidaitan layuka kawai
l-e-e3-b04-06.topic: Manyan haruffan da aka rubuta da madaidaitan layuka
l-e-e3-b04-06.goal: Don gano manyan haruffan da aka rubuta da layukan kwance da na tsaye kawai, tantance ƙa'idar (bayanin) da ake buƙata da gaske, ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-e-e3-b04-06.material: E, F, H, T, L, da I manyan haruffa ne da za a iya rubutawa da layukan kwance da na tsaye kawai. C, O, da S suna da layuka masu lanƙwasa. Rarraba manyan haruffan da ke amfani da madaidaitan layuka kawai.
l-e-e3-b04-06.s.s1.prompt: Wane rukuni ne ya ƙunshi manyan haruffan da aka rubuta da layukan kwance da na tsaye kawai?
l-e-e3-b04-06.s.s1.r.a: C tana da layi mai lanƙwasa.
l-e-e3-b04-06.s.s1.r.c: O tana da layi mai lanƙwasa.
l-e-e3-b04-06.s.s1.r.d: S tana da layi mai lanƙwasa.
l-e-e3-b04-06.s.s1.explain: E, H, da T an rubuta su da layukan kwance da na tsaye kawai. A ɗayan rukunin kuwa C, O, da S sun gauraya.
l-e-e3-b04-06.s.s2.model.0: E, H, da T duk an rubuta su da madaidaitan layuka kawai, don haka wannan rukuni ya cika ƙa'idar.
l-e-e3-b04-06.s.s2.model.1: Ɗayan rukunin yana da haruffa masu lanƙwasa kamar C, O, da S a ciki, don haka E, H, da T sun dace.

l-e-e3-b06-06.s.s1.r.d: Girma ba ma'aunin bambance haruffan biyu ba ne.

l-e-e3-b01-20.s.s1.o.a: Kimanin mintuna 4 da daƙiƙa 30, zai ƙare cikin mintuna 5.
l-e-e3-b01-20.s.s1.o.b: Kimanin minti 1, akwai isasshen lokaci sosai.
l-e-e3-b01-20.s.s1.r.b: Wannan ita ce ƙimar da aka lissafa da daƙiƙa 3~4 ga kowace kalma.
l-e-e3-b01-20.s.s1.r.c: 18 × daƙiƙa 15 ya yi ƙasa sosai da mintuna 15.

l-e-e3-b01-20.s.s1.explain: 18 × 15 = daƙiƙa 270, wato mintuna 4 da daƙiƙa 30. Wannan bai kai mintuna 5 (daƙiƙa 300) ba.
l-e-e3-b01-20.s.s2.model.0: 18 × 15 shi ne daƙiƙa 270, wato mintuna 4 da daƙiƙa 30, saboda haka zai ƙare cikin mintuna 5.
l-e-e3-b01-20.s.s2.model.1: Kalmomi 20 a daƙiƙa 15 kowacce suna ɗaukar mintuna 5, kuma kalmomi 18 sun fi ƙasa da haka, saboda haka lokaci ya isa.

l-e-e3-b03-21.material: Ga yadda aka rubuta “I live in Seoul”. ① Harafin I na farko a jimla babban harafi ne ② live in an rubuta su da ƙananan haruffa ③ Sunan birnin seoul an rubuta shi da ƙananan haruffa ④ An gama: I live in seoul.
l-e-e3-b03-21.s.s1.r.a: I koyaushe babban harafi ne. Farkon jimlar daidai ne.
l-e-e3-b03-21.s.s1.o.b: ② live in ƙananan haruffa ne.
l-e-e3-b03-21.s.s1.r.b: Ana rubuta kalmomin yau da kullum da ƙananan haruffa.
l-e-e3-b03-21.s.s1.o.c: ③ Sunan birnin seoul ƙaramin harafi ne.
l-e-e3-b03-21.s.s1.explain: Sunayen birane da mutane suna farawa da babban harafi. Dole ne a rubuta Seoul.
l-e-e3-b03-21.s.s2.model.0: Dole ne a rubuta sunayen birane da babban harafi, saboda haka rubuta seoul a ③ kuskure ne.
l-e-e3-b03-21.s.s2.model.1: An rubuta ③ da ƙananan haruffa, saboda haka shi ne kuskuren farko; idan an gyara, sai ya zama I live in Seoul.

l-e-e3-b05-31.s.s1.r.d: Ma'aunin ba wahala ba ne, yana nuna tsarin yini ne.
l-e-e3-b05-31.s.s1.explain: Ayyukan kullum suna bin tafiyar yini. Idan an jera bisa farkon lokaci, za a ga abin da aka fara da abin da aka yi daga baya.
l-e-e3-b05-31.s.s2.model.0: Jera bisa lokaci yana nuna yadda yini ke gudana, saboda haka A ta fi dacewa.
